author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Update branding and role terminology across the application
body:
- Changed the theme color in index.html to reflect a new branding direction.
- Updated the application title and description in index.html for better alignment with the new branding.
- Refactored CourseAdmins and Educators components to replace "course admin" and "educator" terminology with "forest keeper" and "gardener," respectively, enhancing clarity and consistency.
- Adjusted various error messages and UI elements to incorporate the new role labels, improving user experience.
- Enhanced CSS styles for a more cohesive visual presentation across components, including animations and background gradients.
- Updated the Login and RolesDashboard components to reflect the new branding and role terminology, ensuring a unified user interface.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Enhance subject selection validation for grades 8, 9, and 10
body:
- Updated the StudentData model and routes to require subject selection for grades 8, 9, and 10, ensuring consistent validation across the application.
- Refactored related functions to streamline grade normalization and subject requirement checks.
- Adjusted frontend components to reflect the new validation rules, improving user feedback and error messages for subject selection.
- Updated documentation for Excel upload requirements to include grades 8, 9, and 10 for subject choices.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Add title and filename generation for PDF in ResultSheet component
body:
- Enhanced the PDF generation functionality by adding a dynamic title based on the selected grade, improving the clarity of the downloaded document.
- Implemented styling for the title in the PDF to enhance visual presentation.
- Streamlined the filename creation process for the PDF download, ensuring consistency and clarity in file naming.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Add PDF download functionality to ResultSheet component
body:
- Implemented a new feature to download the result sheet as a PDF, enhancing user experience by allowing easy access to student records.
- Added CSS styles for download button to improve visibility and interaction.
- Utilized html2canvas and jsPDF libraries to create a visually appealing PDF layout, including student names, subjects, totals, and percentages.
- Introduced error handling for download failures and ensured proper cleanup of temporary DOM elements used during the PDF generation process.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Add signup functionality to Login component
body:
- Introduced a new signup form within the Login component, allowing users to register with student details including name, father's name, grade, and date of birth.
- Implemented validation for required fields and conditional rendering for subject selection based on grade.
- Added CSS styles for the new signup form elements to enhance user experience and maintain consistency with the existing design.
- Integrated a toggle for showing and hiding the signup form, improving the overall user interface.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Add educator assignments and enhance course access control
body:
- Introduced a new field in the User model for educatorAssignments, allowing educators to teach multiple grade and subject combinations.
- Updated role-based access control in course routes to ensure educators can only access courses that match their assigned grades and subjects.
- Enhanced the educator management routes to support the creation and updating of educator assignments, improving flexibility in course assignments.
- Implemented normalization functions for grades and subjects to streamline matching logic across various components, ensuring consistent access control for educators.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Enhance role-based visibility in StudentsRecord component
body:
- Introduced conditional rendering for selection and action columns based on user roles, improving access control for course management.
- Refactored column span calculation to accommodate dynamic visibility of columns, enhancing the user interface and experience.
- Updated toggleSelectionMode function to restrict access for non-managing users, ensuring proper role enforcement.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Refactor role-based access control in App and CurriculumHeader components
body:
- Simplified routing logic in App.js to ensure only 'EDUCATOR' users can navigate to the record page, while 'COURSE_ADMIN' users can access the Curriculum component.
- Updated CurriculumHeader to enhance role-based visibility for navigation buttons, allowing 'COURSE_ADMIN' users to view objectives and grading schemes, improving user experience and access control.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Refactor role-based access control in student data routes and frontend navigation
body:
- Updated backend routes to restrict access to student data management actions to only 'ADMIN' role, removing 'COURSE_ADMIN' from required roles.
- Enhanced frontend routing logic to ensure proper navigation based on user roles, allowing 'EDUCATOR' and 'COURSE_ADMIN' users to navigate to the record page while restricting access to the StudentData component for non-admin users.
- Adjusted visibility of reports in the CurriculumHeader to be accessible only to 'ADMIN' users, improving security and role management.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Refactor error handling in course admin management routes and restore delete functionality
body:
- Enhanced error responses in the course admin creation and deletion routes to include specific error messages.
- Restored the delete route for course admins, ensuring proper validation and error handling for missing usernames and non-existent course admins.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Remove unused selectedCount variable and deleteBulk function from CourseAdmins component to streamline code and improve maintainability.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Add course admin management routes and role-based navigation
body:
- Introduced new route for course admin management in the backend, allowing admin users to manage course admins.
- Updated frontend to include a RolesDashboard and CourseAdmins components, enabling role-based navigation for admin users.
- Enhanced CurriculumHeader to display navigation options for roles, improving user experience and access control.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Update authMiddleware and authRoutes to enforce role-based access for legacy users
body:
- Enhanced authMiddleware to assign 'ADMIN' role to the legacy user 'sapling', while defaulting other users to 'EDUCATOR' if their role is missing.
- Updated authRoutes to ensure the 'sapling' user is always assigned the 'ADMIN' role during user updates, improving security and role management consistency.
- Refactored login response to compute user roles dynamically based on username, ensuring accurate role assignment during authentication.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Add sample user creation for course management and educator assignment
body:
- Updated the user creation logic to include default demo users: Course Admin and Educator, with appropriate roles and passwords.
- Refactored the ensureSampleUser function to ensure multiple sample users are created if they do not exist.
- Implemented automatic assignment of the default educator to courses lacking assigned educators, enhancing course management functionality.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Implement role-based access control and user management features
body:
- Added admin user management routes to handle user-related operations.
- Enhanced authentication middleware to verify user roles and improve security.
- Updated course and record routes to enforce role-based access, ensuring only authorized users can perform certain actions.
- Introduced new fields in the User and Course models to support role management and educator isolation.
- Improved frontend components to reflect role-based navigation and access control, enhancing user experience and security.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Implement subject-based enrollment filtering for Class 8 students
body:
- Added logic to filter enrolled students based on their subject for Class 8, specifically for 'Biology' and 'Computer'.
- Updated the CreateCourseMarks and StudentRecordDetail components to ensure only students with matching subjects are counted in enrollment for grade 8.
- Enhanced the useMemo hook in StudentRecordDetail to compute the course subject for grade 8, improving data accuracy and user experience.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Enhance button styling and layout in Curriculum and StudentsRecord components
body:
- Updated CSS for action buttons in Curriculum and StudentsRecord to improve layout and alignment using flexbox.
- Adjusted padding, font size, and border radius for a more consistent and modern button appearance.
- Modified button text in Curriculum.js for clarity.
- Improved icon alignment within buttons for better visual consistency.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Add Subject column to StudentData table
body:
- Added a new column for 'Subject' in the StudentData component to display subject information alongside student details.
- This enhancement aligns with recent updates to the StudentData model, improving data visibility and user experience.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Add subject choice for Class 8 students in StudentData model and routes
body:
- Introduced a new 'subject' field in the StudentData schema to allow selection between 'Biology' and 'Computer' for Class 8 students.
- Implemented normalization logic for subject input in student data routes, ensuring validation and error handling for subject selection.
- Updated frontend components to include subject selection for adding and editing student data, enhancing user experience and data integrity.
- Modified upload logic to enforce subject requirements for Class 8, improving data validation during file uploads.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Refactor student marks calculation in ResultSheet.js
body:
- Updated the logic for calculating student totals and percentages to only include courses where the student is enrolled, ensuring accuracy in report generation.
- Introduced a new calculation for total maximum grades per student, enhancing the precision of percentage calculations based on actual course enrollments.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Refactor subject sorting logic in ResultSheet.js
body:
- Introduced a constant SUBJECT_ORDER to define the order of subjects for the result sheet, ensuring consistency and clarity.
- Updated the getSubjectSortIndex function to utilize the new SUBJECT_ORDER, improving maintainability and alignment with report generation logic.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Improve student report generation by adding enrollment check
body:
- Added a check to ensure the student is enrolled in the course before calculating the overall percentage, preventing null entries from affecting report accuracy.
- Updated related logic in both report utility and StudentReportDetail components for consistency and clarity.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Remove hardcoded subject groups and mapping from StudentReportDetail.js to streamline report generation logic

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Remove hardcoded SUBJECT_ORDER from ResultSheet.js and clean up imports in StudentReportDetail.js

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Enhance subject sorting and report generation logic
body:
- Introduced a new utility function, getSubjectSortIndex, to standardize subject sorting across report components, ensuring consistent order in report cards.
- Updated sorting logic in student report generation to utilize the new subject sorting function, improving alignment with result sheets.
- Refactored related components to enhance clarity and maintainability in report generation processes.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Update subject mapping in report generation for consistency
body:
- Added additional variants for 'general knowledge' in the SUBJECT_TO_TEMPLATE_KEY across report generation components to ensure accurate subject mapping.
- Enhanced consistency in subject representation, improving alignment with report data.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Enhance subject mapping and marks calculation in student report generation
body:
- Updated the SUBJECT_TO_TEMPLATE_KEY to include additional variants for Urdu, English, Math, and Islamiat, ensuring accurate mapping for report generation.
- Refined the marks calculation logic to round obtained marks to two decimal places, improving accuracy in report data representation.
- Ensured consistency in subject mapping across report generation components for better alignment with result sheets.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Enhance student report generation with improved error handling and validation
body:
- Added error handling for invalid course total marks during report generation, ensuring robustness.
- Implemented validation checks to confirm course existence before processing, enhancing user feedback.
- Updated report generation logic to handle edge cases more effectively, improving overall accuracy.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Implement course total marks calculation in student report generation
body:
- Added a new utility function to calculate total marks for a course based on question part marks and topics.
- Updated report generation logic to utilize actual course total marks instead of a fixed percentage, enhancing accuracy in marks aggregation.
- Ensured that only courses with valid total marks are processed, improving the robustness of the report data.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Update subject display order and sorting logic in report generation
body:
- Introduced a consistent display order for subjects in report generation, enhancing clarity and organization.
- Updated the logic for merging Oral/Written subjects to ensure accurate representation in reports.
- Implemented sorting of enrolled courses based on the new SUBJECT_DISPLAY_ORDER, improving the overall report structure.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Add sequential fetching of course records for improved report generation
body:
- Implemented a new function to fetch all course records sequentially, reducing the risk of partial failures during downloads.
- Updated the PDF generation logic to utilize fetched records, allowing for more accurate report data.
- Added error handling for failed record fetches to enhance robustness.
- Included validation to ensure courses exist before attempting to download reports, improving user feedback.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Refactor canvas rendering for student report sections in PDF generation
body:
- Separated the rendering of the first objective section from the rest, improving clarity and organization in the PDF output.
- Utilized Promise.all for concurrent rendering of remaining sections, enhancing performance during PDF generation.
- Updated the logic for adding canvases to the PDF to reflect the new structure, ensuring accurate representation of report sections.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Refactor PDF generation in student reports to streamline canvas rendering
body:
- Combined cover and objective sections into a single canvas for improved efficiency in PDF generation.
- Simplified the logic for adding canvases to the PDF, enhancing readability and performance.
- Updated the image slicing logic to ensure proper handling of large canvases during PDF creation.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Add watermark functionality and optimize PDF generation in student reports
body:
- Implemented a watermark feature for student report PDFs to enhance branding consistency.

- Removed the hasExistingRecord state from StudentRecordDetail.js, simplifying state management related to record existence.
- Cleaned up the code in both components to enhance readability and maintainability.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Add marks and objectiveMarks fields to Course and Record schemas, respectively
body:
- Introduced a new 'marks' field in the Course schema to capture topic-specific marks.
- Added 'objectiveMarks' field in the Record schema to store marks associated with each course objective.
- Updated course creation logic to validate total marks, ensuring they sum to 100.
- Enhanced the StudentRecordDetail component to manage and display objective marks for students.
- Made corresponding updates to the frontend for handling marks input and display in the curriculum and student record views.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Refactor Curriculum component by removing unused state and code
body:
- Eliminated the currentView state and related logic for managing student data view, simplifying the component structure.
- Removed the StudentData import and associated rendering logic, streamlining the curriculum display.
- Cleaned up the code to enhance readability and maintainability.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Refactor Curriculum component by removing unused functions
body:
- Removed the toggleCourseDetails function to streamline course selection and expansion logic.
- Deleted the handleStudentsDataClick function, as it is no longer needed for the current view management.
- Cleaned up the code to improve readability and maintainability.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Add subject field to objective schema and enhance file upload error handling
body:
- Introduced a new 'subject' field in the objective schema of Curriculum.js to capture additional information for each objective.
- Enhanced error handling in curriculumRoutes.js for file uploads, providing detailed solutions for common issues such as missing columns and invalid file types.
- Updated the Curriculum.js component to manage the new subject field in the objective form and improve user feedback during file uploads.
- Added new CSS styles in Curriculum.css for error messages and upload buttons to enhance the user experience during objective management.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Enhance file upload button in StudentData component
body:
- Updated the upload button text to display the name of the selected file when available, improving user feedback during the file upload process.
- Added a title attribute to the button for better accessibility and clarity on the file being uploaded.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Add course deletion functionality and enhance UI for course management
body:
- Implemented DELETE endpoints in courseRoutes.js to allow deletion of all courses and individual courses by code, including associated records.
- Enhanced the StudentsRecord.js component to manage course deletion with confirmation prompts and loading states.
- Added new CSS styles in StudentsRecord.css for delete buttons and actions to improve user experience and visual feedback during deletion actions.
- Updated the UI to include a button for deleting all courses, with appropriate state management for loading indicators.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Refactor file upload handling and enhance UI for student data management
body:
- Removed deprecated file upload components and streamlined the file handling logic in StudentData.js.
- Introduced a new file input reference to manage file selection and improved validation for file types.
- Updated CSS styles in StudentData.css to enhance the upload section and error messaging for better user experience.
- Added responsive design adjustments for the add student form to accommodate various screen sizes.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Add student management features and enhance UI for individual student addition
body:
- Implemented a new POST endpoint in studentDataRoutes.js to add individual student records with validation for required fields.
- Added error handling for duplicate registration numbers and invalid date formats.
- Enhanced the frontend StudentData.js component to include a form for adding students, managing state for input fields, and handling submission with appropriate error messages.
- Introduced new CSS styles in StudentData.css for the add student form and error messages to improve user experience.
- Added functionality to delete multiple students by registration numbers with confirmation prompts and state management for loading indicators.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Add fathersName field to StudentData model and update related functionality
body:
- Introduced a new field 'fathersName' in the StudentData model to capture additional student information.
- Updated the student data update handler to include 'fathersName' in the request body and validation logic.
- Enhanced the file upload functionality to check for 'Fathers Name' in the required columns and provide appropriate error messages.
- Modified the frontend to manage 'fathersName' in the edit form and display relevant error messages during file uploads.
- Updated CSS to style error messages for better user experience during uploads.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Enhance authentication middleware and frontend token management
body:
- Updated JWT expiration time from 2 minutes to 20 minutes for improved session longevity.
- Added a new endpoint for refreshing tokens, allowing clients to obtain a new token while active.
- Implemented inactivity detection and token refresh logic in the frontend to maintain user sessions without requiring re-login.
- Removed the automatic token update from response headers, shifting to a manual refresh approach for better control.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Add delete functionality for curriculum objectives
body:
- Implemented two DELETE endpoints in curriculumRoutes.js: one for deleting all objectives and another for deleting a specific objective by grade and code.
- Enhanced the Curriculum.js component to include handlers for deleting objectives, with confirmation prompts and state management for loading indicators.
- Added new CSS styles in Curriculum.css for delete buttons to improve user experience and visual feedback during deletion actions.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Add functionality to add individual objectives to the curriculum
body:
- Implemented a new POST endpoint in curriculumRoutes.js to handle adding single objectives with validation for grade input.
- Enhanced the Curriculum.js component to include a form for adding objectives, managing state for input fields, and handling submission.
- Added corresponding CSS styles for the new objective input form in Curriculum.css to improve user experience.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Implement authentication and file upload features in the curriculum management system
body:
- Added JWT authentication middleware to protect API routes.
- Integrated login functionality in the frontend with local storage for authentication tokens.
- Implemented file upload feature for curriculum objectives, allowing users to upload Excel or CSV files.
- Enhanced the UI with upload buttons and file input handling in Curriculum.js and associated CSS styles.
- Updated server.js to include new auth routes and middleware for secure access to curriculum data.

author: M Abdullah Abbasi
subject: Add student update functionality and enhance UI for editing records
body:
- Implemented a new PUT endpoint to update student records by registration number in studentDataRoutes.js.
- Added state management for editing student data in StudentData.js, including form handling and validation.
- Enhanced the UI in StudentData.js to allow inline editing of student records with appropriate buttons for saving and canceling edits.
- Updated CSS styles in StudentData.css to improve the appearance of edit inputs and buttons.
- Increased API timeout in Curriculum.js for better performance in production.
